body_markdown:
*Fundraise Insider tracks newly funded startups each week and delivers verified[sales leads](https://fundraiseinsider.com/) of C-suite contacts straight to your inbox, so you reach the right people while the funding is still fresh.[See pricing.](https://fundraiseinsider.com/pricing)*


EULER has raised $4.3 million in a[seed round](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/seed-startups/) led by Channel Equity Partners, its first institutional capital after a stretch of profitable growth.


The company is based in San Diego,[California](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/california-startups/) , and sells an agentic partner relationship management platform, a corner of enterprise tooling that rarely draws headlines but sits directly on top of revenue.


Partner programs are administratively heavy by nature. Onboarding, training, enablement, deal registration, attribution and ongoing partner support all involve repetitive coordination across companies that do not share systems. EULER points AI agents at that work, automating the steps that normally consume a channel team’s week.


The customer list gives a sense of scale. The platform supports more than 100,000 partnerships for clients including Gong, BambooHR, Zip and BigCommerce, all B2B[software](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/software-startups/) businesses where indirect revenue matters enough to justify dedicated infrastructure. Founder and CEO Greg Portnoy runs the company.


The new money funds hiring across engineering, product, sales, customer success and marketing, faster product development, and a larger go-to-market operation.


Teams selling into newly funded software companies can find verified decision makers through[B2B software sales leads](https://fundraiseinsider.com/saas-lead-generation/) refreshed as rounds are announced.
